Subject: Post-commit orchestration lattice & MAP for Silverpine - sequencing & canary plan

Hi Emily / Tom —

Congrats again on signing. I put together an initial mutual action plan (MAP) that folds in implementation sequencing, a short canary migration approach, and the training milestones so we can align on an actual go-live window. Attached: Silverpine_MAP_v1.xlsx (worksheet: "Lattice - milestones").

High-level ask from our side for the upcoming week:
- Confirm target pilot cluster (region + teams) — you mentioned US-West for pilot, correct?
- Share preferred dates for the two-week training window (we recommend 10/25–11/05 or 11/08–11/19).
- Identify any compliance gating items we should elevate now (audit logs/KMS details).

Proposed sequencing (in the MAP):
1) Provisioning & infra readiness (2 business days)
2) Canary migration on a single service path with traffic slicing (3 days)
3) Training: admin + engineers (2x half-day sessions)
4) Ramp-to-100% with rollback gates (5 days)

I've looped Marissa to coordinate ops runbooks and Ben for the canary checklist. If that looks good, we'll lock dates and move to canary prep.

Thanks —
Mateo
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Mateo — this looks sensible and thorough.

Quick answers:
- Pilot cluster: confirmed US-West (cluster-id: sp-west-3).
- Training: prefer 11/08–11/19 window to avoid a rollout overlap with our Q4 feature freeze (can do the two half-day sessions the first week).
- Compliance: we'll need the KMS key rotation plan and a scoped audit log extract for our security review; I can put both items on our procurement queue this week.

Two asks from us:
1) Can you include a short fallback/rollback plan for the embedding cache warm-up? We worry about user-experience blips during early traffic.
2) Can you confirm whether Dedicated capacity needs an explicit DNS cutover or if we can use path-based routing for the pilot?

Happy to jump on a 30 min sync if easier.

Best,

Subject: Re: Post-commit orchestration lattice & MAP for Silverpine - sequencing & canary plan

Emily / team —

Quick notes from the canary perspective: we've built a compact checklist for the migration run (attached: canary-matrix-checklist.pdf). Highlights:
- Traffic slice config: start at 2% -> 10% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 24h hold windows between escalations.
- Latency SLO gating: average p95 <= 220ms and error-rate <0.5% for two consecutive holds before escalation.
- Cache warm-up: pre-populate top 500 queries with synthetic traffic 6 hours before first 2% slice. Fallback: route to hosted variant and mark degraded in telemetry.
- DNS: for Dedicated we can do path-based routing via the ingress (no DNS flip required) provided your infra team can add the path rule to ALB. If that's not viable, we will support a DNS cutover plan and a TTL pre-lower.

I'll note these items in the MAP and add the canary checklist as a tab. Will also include a small runbook for quick rollback.

—Ben
Principal Infra PM | Redwood Inference
Attachment: canary-matrix-checklist.pdf
